note: Engine owns sequence, 3000㎡ occupancy baseline and scaling. Client supplies intake facts only — not durations. Q/R/C and floors do not govern.

construction_package_sequence.name: 行业特种现场包（机房/动捕等）

lanes.SCALE_RESEARCHED: Has activity_type in L2 baseline table; b0 is the reference-area occupancy.
lanes.SCALE_TEMPLATE: Sector/unlisted site work; engine treats template days as b0 at the reference area. Not used for flushout/IAQ/move-in/design/tender/cutover.
lanes.STATUTORY_LOCK: Government permit / fire / completion — not area scaling. Inclusion may be programme policy, not verified legal applicability.
lanes.TIMED_TEST: Clock-time tests (72h load bank, acoustic sample).
lanes.NOT_SITE: Design, tender, TDD, IT cutover, FM, move-in, IAQ sample, flushout SOP, payments. Never area-scaled.
